p.src: 1  Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

en: Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.
u.src: 1  Blessed is everyone who fears the LORD, who walks in his ways.

p.src: 2  For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

en: For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.
u.src: 2  For you will eat the labor of your hands. You will be happy, and it will be well with you.

p.src: 3  Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

en: Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.
u.src: 3  Your wife will be as a fruitful vine in the innermost parts of your house, your children like olive shoots around your table.

p.src: 4  Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

en: Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.
u.src: 4  Behold, this is how the man who fears the LORD is blessed.

p.src: 5  May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

en: May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.
u.src: 5  May the LORD bless you out of Zion, and may you see the good of Jerusalem all the days of your life.

p.src: 6  Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.

en: Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
u.src: 6  Yes, may you see your children’s children. Peace be upon Israel.
